limits: Structural checks do not prove mathematics, anonymous eligibility, or empirical validity. Visually inspect after edits.
visual_review: Final page 1 visually inspected; pages 2–12 render-identical to the preceding verified PDF.
test_plan_scope: Module suites document assertions in test names/comments; a separate integration plan and release-candidate requirement matrix map behavior to tests. No claim of a separate large plan for every module or newly passed tests.
real_project_fixtures: Scanner and writer embed trimmed public-project manifests; these are fixture tests, not independent production deployments.
full_suite_gate: release.yml requires dispat run tests --since all before the release job; selection is not narrowed to changed packages.
binary_gate_scope: Dockerfile checks release outputs before export, runs a smoke subset against the native Go release binary, and has TinyGo integration acceptance with an explicit opt-out and a named exclusion. Not all cross-compiled binaries receive the full suite before publication.
post_release_scope: Published CLI installation/version checks run on Linux, macOS and Windows; exact npm versions are installed on the configured OS/architecture matrix. These configured checks do not add native-Windows research measurements.
evidence_limits: Read-only source inspection; no product tests, experiments or releases executed, and no historical observations changed.
